clips.title: The story
paras: Glorin Steelbrow needs Lightforge iron from a shipwreck off the Wetlands. The chest holds only one ingot, and the Bluegill murlocs have taken the rest.

The Flying Osprey lies broken off the Wetlands shore. Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarven priest, sent you to recover its Lightforge iron. The waterlogged chest in the cargo hold holds only a single ingot. Bluegill murlocs near the wreck have scavenged the rest of the shipment.

Lightforge iron is rare metal suited to sacred smithing. Glorin Steelbrow needs it for a weapon, so the bars cannot be left in Bluegill camps. Hunt the Bluegill raiders in the shallows near the broken hull and reclaim the scattered ingots for Glorin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Having grabbed the single lightforge ingot from the waterlogged chest, it is clear that murlocs have stolen the rest. Hunt the murloc raiders near the Flying Osprey wreckage for the lost lightforge iron.
